title: Checkout is timing out
alert: Checkout errors rose after the 14:05 release. Payments looks noisy too. Find the likely cause and propose a safe next step.

title: Every payment is being declined
alert: Payment success dropped suddenly at 09:00. There was no release this morning. Investigate before proposing a rollback.

title: Sold-out products still look available
alert: The storefront shows stock that the order service rejects. Error rates are low. Check inventory consistency rather than assuming the database is down.
